purpose: test matched-residual settings selected on final controlled validation output
chronos: reuse identical archived fold caches; zero adaptation steps
tree_settings: L1/15 leaves/14-day half-life; if duplicate, L2/7 leaves/no weighting
full_residual_stopping: validation MAE after calibrated congestion mixture; max1600 trees, patience60
blind_residual_stopping: validation residual MAE; max1600 trees, patience60
candidate_selection: mean MAE of final controlled validation output, with strictly earlier-day policy calibration
simple_baseline: Chronos median plus ordinary full-information LightGBM residual, independently selected from the same two tree settings; native residual MAE stopping, no shrinkage, no router
supply_baseline: independently select reference, paired tree setting and shrinkage with gamma=0 using the same controlled validation objective
calibration: reuse archived class probabilities and selected mapping methods; refit matched residuals inside the three chronological downstream OOF blocks
scope: downstream OOF conditional on frozen outer-fold Chronos; no new full upstream cross-fitting claim
selection_freeze: all fold configurations frozen before candidate test inference
test_interpretation: previously inspected seasonal development registry; independent confirmation requires previously unused later data
